0.8.0.en: First publication of the app in test.

0.8.1.en: Updates to cluster connection and resilience, the app now collects ip adresses of all te nodes in the cluster and uses these adresses as fallback for when the original ip/hostname is not reachable. Added capabilities for fallback connection and active address.

0.8.2.en: Fixed flow and device cards issues when multiple devices are created. Added shutdown node device cards.

0.8.3.en: Changed node offline behavior, app icons and images.

0.9.0.en: Major Update: Added Node-level monitoring (VM/LXC counts), Robust Cluster Failover with auto-discovery of backup hosts, and significant performance/polling optimizations.

1.0.0.en: Production Release: Strict timeout fixes, polling persistence fixes, and UI improvements.

1.0.1.en: Fixed a startup crash (race condition) where the app could restart continuously.

1.0.2.en: Improved startup resilience: Nodes now automatically retry if the cluster is not yet ready.

1.0.3.en: Fixed an issue where nodes could appear offline after a restart due to initialization timing.

1.0.4.en: Improved startup stability: Proactive check to ensure cluster lies ready before node initialization.

1.0.5.en: Optimization: Instant failback to the Primary Node as soon as it becomes available.

1.0.6.en: Certification Fixes: Updated app description and driver icons.

1.0.7.en: UI Improvements: Updated App Icon and optimized driver icons.

1.1.0.en: Major Update: Added Flow triggers (VM start/stop, node online/offline, fallback, cluster quorum, CPU/memory thresholds), Reboot and Migrate VM/Container actions, a new per-VM/Container device driver, cluster quorum and node disk usage sensors, an optional API port field for reverse proxy setups, connection performance improvements, and fixed the Stop Node (Force) action which previously always failed.

1.2.0.en: Added Homey dashboard widgets: Cluster Overview (counts, fallback/quorum status, storage usage), Node Detail (CPU/Memory/Disk, VM/LXC counts, online status), and VM/Container Control (live start/shutdown buttons).

1.2.1.en: Widget fixes: much smaller preview images, and a diagnostic build to pin down device selection in widgets.

1.2.2.en: Restored the default widget preview images (the smaller custom placeholders didn't look good).

1.2.3.en: Fixed widgets not finding devices: they now use the Homey Web API to resolve devices, which requires a new permission. Widget device selection, live data, and VM/Container start-stop buttons should now work correctly.

1.2.4.en: Removed the homey:manager:api permission added in 1.2.3: widgets now pick their device via a built-in search field instead of Homey's device picker, which needs no extra permission. VM/Container Control is now one VM/Container per widget - add multiple widgets to monitor several.

1.2.5.en: Added Snapshot Create/Rollback, Backup VM/Container (vzdump), bulk Start/Shutdown all VMs/Containers on a Node, and new VM/Container metrics (Uptime, Network In/Out).

1.2.6.en: VM/Container icons now match Proxmox VE's own web UI (Font Awesome's desktop/cube icons), including the Proxmox VM/Container driver icon which previously reused the generic app logo.

1.2.7.en: Fixed a bug where VM and Container devices always showed the same icon (the per-device icon path was wrong). New Container devices now correctly show the Container icon, and gained a Disk Usage sensor (LXC-only - not reliably available for VMs without the guest agent).
